name: HookShot
description: Point and click: a spring-loaded spearhead shoots out on its chain and hauls you straight to what it bites: bricks, the map, players and vehicles. Tap to fly there and land; hold to hang there, reeling in with jump and out with crouch, until you click again. Type /hookshot for one. Based on the Hookshot by Loz and the Grappling Hook by Conan.
